policy: Rewrite callers and training data directly. Do not provide compatibility modes or codecs.

changes.old: Model-written eval declarations may omit type annotations
changes.new: Every model-written declaration carries the checker's inferred natlang type
changes.migration: Insert inferred annotations into model-written eval code of every trajectory (spec/NEURALESE_DATA.md, Eager typing). Skip any/unknown/inexpressible types and count them.
required_cases: declarations whose inferred type is unknown are left unchanged
rewritten eval compiles with identical diagnostics and replays unchanged
changes.status: specified; builders and verification are S1 work items

changes.old: Inline nl captures bindings by name mention only
changes.new: nl.with({ ... }) lists captures; live(x) marks written-back let captures; function-typed captures are snapshots
changes.migration: Rewrite inline nl sites to nl.with with exactly the analysed capture set (spec/NEURALESE_DATA.md, Explicit captures).
required_cases: let capture with write-back becomes live(x)
capture set equals the original analysis
rewritten program replays unchanged including write-backs
changes.status: specified; builders and verification are S1 work items

changes.old: Callable folders with an identity-based caller-chain recursion guard; iterateOn requires a measure or limit for every predicate
changes.new: Functions curried over immutable contexts with rebinding; structural termination (acyclic contexts, function-typed captures by value, no recursive function types); iterateOn requires a bound only for TypeScript predicates or with the judge off
changes.migration: Training data showing recursion-guard errors or mandatory bounds on natural-language predicates is regenerated under the new runtime; natural-language predicates are recollected under the dedicated predicate prompt.
required_cases: TypeScript predicate without bound is rejected
natural-language predicate without bound runs under the predicate prompt
recursive function type alias is rejected
changes.status: specified; runtime in S4, data regeneration in S1
